K.G. Admission — Academic Session 2027

“Glow in Integrity”

Parent / Guardian User Guide
Portal: https://admission.turapublicschool.com/
Help email: info@turapublicschool.com
Last date to apply: 25th September, 2026 (Friday)
Application fee: ₹100 (bank transfer)
Please read before you begin Online registration does not guarantee admission. Seats are limited. Names must match original birth and caste certificates. Keep your Application Number and 6-digit PIN safe.

1. Who can apply?

  • Admission class: K.G. for Academic Session 2027.
  • Age as on 1st January 2027: At least 5 years and not more than 6 years.
  • The child must have attended Nursery.
  • Parent / guardian must have a working mobile number and email address (OTP is sent to email).

2. What you need ready

Item Notes
Child’s full name Enter in BLOCK LETTERS, exactly as on the child’s birth certificate
Date of birth Age as on 1st January 2027: at least 5 years and not more than 6 years
Parent email & mobile Email receives OTP and application messages
Passport photograph School uniform preferred · JPG / JPEG / PNG only
Certificates Birth, school, income, and category certificates as applicable · JPG / JPEG / PNG only (PDF not accepted)
₹100 fee payment Bank transfer + Transaction / UTR number + receipt image

3. How to register (create your login)

  1. Open the portal

    Go to https://admission.turapublicschool.com/ on a computer or mobile browser. Prefer Chrome / Edge / Firefox.

  2. Start registration

    Choose Register. Fill:

    • Child’s full name (BLOCK LETTERS)
    • Date of birth
    • Gender
    • Parent / guardian mobile
    • Parent / guardian email

  3. Verify email with OTP

    Click Send OTP. Open the parent email inbox (and Spam/Junk). Enter the 6-digit OTP. Tick the confirmation that the child attended Nursery and meets the age rule. After Create Application, a second email will send the application number and a 6-digit login PIN.

  4. Get login details

    After successful registration you receive an email with an Application Number (example format: TPS27-0001) and a 6-digit login PIN. Save both. You will use them to log in.

Already registered? Do not register again with the same email or mobile. Use Login or Forgot PIN on the portal.

4. How to log in

  1. Open https://admission.turapublicschool.com/
  2. Go to Login
  3. Enter Application Number / registered email and 6-digit PIN
  4. You will see the Dashboard with steps: Application Form → Documents → Fee & Receipt → Review & Submit

5. Fill the Application Form

Open Application Form from the top menu. Complete every section carefully. You can save progress and return later until final submission.

5.1 Child details

  • Full name, date of birth, gender, blood group
  • Caste / Category and Community / Tribe (this decides which certificates are required)
  • Nationality, last school attended, Nursery attendance

5.2 Address

  • Enter Permanent address fully, including PIN code
  • If Present address is the same, use Same as permanent (if shown)
  • Otherwise fill Present address completely

5.3 Father & Mother details

  • Name, occupation, education, mobile, and other fields as asked
  • Income details must match the income certificates you will upload

5.4 Sibling (if any)

If a brother/sister already studies in Tura Public School, fill sibling details as requested. Otherwise mark No / leave as guided on screen.

Tip Spell names exactly as on certificates. Wrong spelling can delay verification or cause rejection of documents.

6. Upload documents

Open Documents. Upload clear colour photos/scans. Allowed types: JPG, JPEG, PNG only. PDF files are not accepted.

Documents required for all applicants

#Document
1Passport photograph (school uniform preferred)
2Birth Certificate of the Child
3Last school report card
4Last school certificate
5Father’s income certificate
6Mother’s income certificate

Additional certificates (by category)

Child’s category / communityUpload
General / URCaste Certificate
ST — Garo / Khasi / JaintiaMother’s ST Certificate
SCFather’s SC Certificate
OBCFather’s OBC Certificate

If a certificate has more than one page, upload each page as a separate image where the portal allows extra pages.

You may replace a file before final submission if you uploaded the wrong image.

7. Pay the application fee & upload receipt

  1. Transfer ₹100 to the school account

    Account nameTura Public School
    Account number10949575002
    IFSCSBIN0000198
    BankState Bank of India
    BranchSBI Main Branch Tura
    Amount₹100

    While transferring, mention your Application Number in the payment remark/reference if your bank allows it.

  2. Enter Transaction / UTR number

    On Fee & Receipt, enter the bank Transaction ID / UTR exactly as shown in your bank SMS/app. This is not the same as your Application Number.

  3. Upload payment receipt image

    Upload a clear JPG/JPEG/PNG of the transfer receipt or screenshot. You can replace or remove the receipt before final submission if needed.

8. Review & final submit

  1. Open Review & Submit

    Check every section: child details, address, parents, documents, and payment.

  2. Confirm and submit

    Only when all required items are complete, click final submit. After submission the application is locked for editing.

  3. Download PDF

    Download the final Application PDF and keep a copy. It includes your form details and uploaded document images.

After submission The school office will verify payment and documents. Watch your registered email / portal status for updates. For help, write to info@turapublicschool.com.

9. Parent checklist (tick before you submit)

10. Common problems & solutions

ProblemWhat to do
OTP not received Check Spam/Junk; wait 1–2 minutes; request OTP again; confirm email spelling
Date of birth not accepted Age as on 1st January 2027 must be at least 5 years and not more than 6 years. A wrong year of birth will be rejected on submit
“Already registered” Use Login with the same email/mobile. Do not create a second account
Upload rejected / PDF not allowed Convert the page to JPG/JPEG/PNG and upload again
Cannot submit Complete form + required docs + UTR + receipt. Check Review page for missing items
Forgot PIN Use Forgot PIN on the portal; OTP goes to registered parent email. Set a new 6-digit PIN.
